plan.major: Human Services - Related Studies in Human Services Concentration
notes: Source: Kennesaw State University official Academic Maps (4-Year Suggested Program Map), https://public-apps.kennesaw.edu/academic-maps/programs/T0001172. Map label suffix "26" denotes the 2026-2027 catalog.
Prerequisites converted from KSU's boolean prerequisite expressions (AND/OR with minimum grades); minimum-grade qualifiers omitted; non-course requirements (null-code entries) omitted.

Choice slots (code null in source) carry the official option text in choice_note and parsed course options in options; prerequisite references to option courses not placed in-plan are listed in external_prereqs per the collection rule.

Program description (from official map): The Human Services (HS) major prepares professionals to/engage, advocate, and innovate locally, regionally, and globally to improve the lives of peoples and communities. Majors must complete two required field experiences i.e., internships. The foundation internship requires students to demonstrate knowledge, attitudes, and skills acquired in lower-level major courses by completing assignments and experiences in both micro and macro level practice. Students then complete an advanced internship with a focus on the competencies of their chosen concentration.

Related Studies Elective (1 of 6) Select 18 credit hours, with a minimum of 9 credit hours of 3000-4000 level coursework that blend learning in Human Services with another related field. Students should take electives courses in this concentration that composes a pathway to support learning in the major. The pathway may be a certificate, minor, or an approved collection of courses planned in consultation with the program director designee.
